name: xak9-diffline-overflow
description: an expanded diff line longer than its box must truncate visibly (ellipsis), not silently escape its container with no signal that content is missing (kata xak9)

mutation.declaration: diffblock.module.css: .content { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden } (BOTH removed together - each alone is independently sufficient via Chrome's flex auto-minimum-zero rule, so a single-property regression would not be caught; noted for Jesse, not fixed)
mutation.note: Re-verified under styles/global.css (kata e4sh): still fails, content overflows .root by 816.8px.
